subject: Observability add-ons: retention, tracing & advanced dashboards — commercial options
messages:
From: Dana Mills <dana.mills@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboards — pricing & trial?

Hi Jordan,

We're evaluating Redwood for inference and want clarity on the add-on pricing for observability. Specifically: retention tiers (30/90/365 days), tracing (full-span sampling vs event-level), and your advanced dashboards package (per-seat vs per-ingest). Our platform team wants to prototype with a limited set of models and would like a short trial so we can validate latency/cost tradeoffs.

Questions:
- Do you have a simple SKU/per-month pricing table for those three add-ons?
- Any volume discounts or committed usage paths for retention storage?
- Can we run a 60–90 day trial with usage credits and a temporary expanded tracing sample rate for 2 weeks?
- Any special procurement/PO requirements we should know about?

Looping in procurement (cc'd) if they want to chime in. Looking for a clear commercial path so we can move to pilot quickly.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Mills
Head of Platform
Acme Corp

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Mills <dana.mills@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention/tracing/dashboards — commercial options

Hi Dana — great to hear from you, and thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and a suggested pilot path below. Attached is a concise pricing grid (rdw_pricing_grid_q3_2027.pdf).

TL;DR:
- Retention: SKU tiers at 30/90/365 days; unit pricing per GB-month with step discounts at 5TB and 25TB committed monthly.
- Tracing: default sampled traces + ability to enable full-span for pilot window; pricing by ingested trace-event with a metric credit model.
- Dashboards: advanced dashboards are per-seat for editors + a per-project visualization quota for heavy ingest.
- Trial: we can do a 90-day pilot with $25k in usage credits and two weeks of elevated tracing sample rate for up to 10 models.

Suggested next steps (if this works to scope the pilot):
1) I'll put together the pilot SOW and a bill-of-materials (SOW draft attached).
2) Provide a HubSpot link for the deal and a single DocuSign for the SOW/credit agreement.
3) Technical kickoff with our Solutions Engineer to wire up telemetry and enable KV/prefix caching for your test models.

Pricing snippet (illustrative):
- Retention 30d: $0.10 / GB-month
- Retention 90d: $0.08 / GB-month
- Retention 365d: $0.045 / GB-month
- Tracing ingest: $0.005 / event (sampling tiers available)
- Advanced dashboards: $40 / editor-seat / month + $0.02 / 1k charts beyond quota

If you want, Soojin (cc) can outline commercial concession paths for committed usage. Kimberly will help with procurement questions. Happy to hop on a call this week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-corp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Dana Mills <dana.mills@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — procurement clarifications

Thanks Jordan — quick procurement notes from our side:
- We prefer a fixed monthly committed spend for the pilot to simplify PO processing. Can you translate the credit proposal into a 3-month fixed pilot fee?
- Any SLA implications if we push traces to elevated sample rates for that 2-week window? We need assurance on retention durability and export capabilities for audit.
- Can we get line-item pricing to feed to our SOW and internal PO?

Ideally we'd avoid a complicated variable billing during the pilot. If you can provide a simple fixed pilot fee that maps to your $25k credit proposal, we'll be able to raise a PO quickly.

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — proposed commercial concession & pilot structure

Jordan / Kimberly — draft response we can send to Acme that keeps us within standard concession bands but matches procurement asks. Please review and flag any compliance issues.

Proposed commercial terms (concise):
- Pilot fee: $22,500 for 90 days (fixed), covers up to $25k of measured consumption across retention, tracing, and dashboards. Overages billed at standard list rates monthly.
- Retention commitments: if Acme commits to a 12-month 10TB/month retention min after pilot we will credit 15% off listed retention rates; commit to 25TB/month => 25% credit.
- Tracing elevated window: allow two-week full-span tracing at no extra charge during pilot subject to Fair Use cap of 50M trace events; exportable raw traces for audit within 30 days post-pilot.
- Dashboards: provide 2 editor seats free during pilot; additional seats at $30/seat/mo for pilot period.
- Procurement: we accept standard PO + 30 days net. No unusual legal concessions.

Attachments: SOW draft (acme_sow_observability_draft.docx) and updated pricing grid (rdw_pricing_grid_q3_2027.pdf). Also adding HubSpot deal link for tracking.

Suggested reply to Acme (one-liner): "We can run a fixed-fee 90-day pilot at $22,500 that maps to the $25k credit; if that’s acceptable we’ll send the SOW and DocuSign this afternoon."

Notes: If they push for deeper discounts upfront, escalate to Markus (cc'd) who owns strategic concession approvals for enterprise pilots.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
